description:
## [1.6.0](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0) (2026-08-24)

### ✨ New Features

* **gboard:** remove incomplete Free Cursor 2D Trackpad patch ([2a9e760](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/2a9e7602266229f1cb36ae6110f57e11dbd0b0b0))

patches.name: Block Brave Telemetry
patches.description: Blocks P3A product analytics, Brave Stats usage pings, crash dump uploads, WDP, and Variations seed fetching.

patches.name: Brave In-Product Notification Scheduler Optimization
patches.description: Eliminates periodic background wakeups and native library loading caused by Chromium in-product tips/promo scheduler (Job ID 105).

patches.name: Brave Origin
patches.description: Unlocks Brave Origin and enables local feature toggle controls.

patches.name: Brave Startup Performance Optimization
patches.description: Optimizes startup time and eliminates background CPU/disk overhead by disabling unused OEM carrier partner customizations.

patches.name: Disable Background Sync & Periodic Sync
patches.description: Eliminates background wakeups, radio modem activity, and battery drain by forcing GooglePlayServicesChecker.shouldDisableBackgroundSync() -> true and neutralizing wakeup tasks.

patches.name: Disable Battery Status API & OS Listener
patches.description: Neutralizes the Android BatteryStatusManager broadcast listener to prevent continuous OS battery wakeups.

patches.name: Disable Pull To Refresh
patches.description: Completely disables the pull-to-refresh overscroll gesture and animation to prevent accidental page reloads.

patches.name: Locale PAK Slimmer
patches.description: Strips unselected language resource PAKs from assets/locales/.

options.description: Comma-separated locale codes to keep (e.g. 'es, es-419, en-US, pt-BR, fr, de'). English (en-US) is always kept as a safe fallback.

patches.name: Skip First Run
patches.description: Skips the welcome screen, search engine selection, and onboarding First Run Experience (FRE) on clean installs.

patches.name: Add AMOLED Theme
patches.description: Adds a selectable Pure Black AMOLED theme using Gboard's native color_black theme package, without replacing Dark, Light, System Auto, or Dynamic Color.

patches.name: Allow Modified APK
patches.description: Bypasses internal signature check to allow custom APK execution.

patches.name: Block Telemetry
patches.description: Disables background metrics dispatch, event logging, daily pings, and crash reporting.

patches.name: Clone Gboard
patches.description: Changes the package name by appending a dot and custom suffix (defaults to 'kveld') to allow installing Gboard alongside the original application.

options.description: Suffix appended after the original package name and a dot (e.g. 'kveld' -> 'com.google.android.inputmethod.latin.kveld').

patches.name: Disable Diagnostics
patches.description: Disables Google's diagnostic and recovery telemetry.

patches.name: Disable Google Primes
patches.description: Neutralizes Google Primes performance profiling, jank monitoring, native crash sidecars, and background telemetry threads.

patches.name: Disable In-App Training
patches.description: Neutralizes periodic in-app training cache generation and federated-learning background work while preserving normal keyboard functionality and explicit user-requested operations.

patches.name: Disable MDD Background Sync
patches.description: Neutralizes Mobile Data Download (MDD) periodic background synchronization, automated polling, and prefetch worker tasks while preserving on-demand and user-requested downloads.

patches.name: Disable Remote Configuration
patches.description: Disables periodic remote experiment flag synchronization and background updates.

patches.name: Disable Superpacks Eager Sync
patches.description: Neutralizes eager background Superpacks synchronization during application startup, eliminating unnecessary disk sweeps and network polling while preserving on-demand pack downloads.

patches.name: Disable Tenor Share Tracking
patches.description: Disables Tenor GIF selection and share tracking telemetry.

patches.name: Disable WorkManager
patches.description: Neutralizes background WorkManager initialization, database creation, and periodic maintenance workers.

patches.name: Enable Access Points Menu Redesign
patches.description: Enables the redesigned access points menu bar and customization panel (Panel V2).

patches.name: Enable Key Shape Selection
patches.description: Enables the key border shape selection UI (Default, Semi-rounded, Round) in theme customization.

patches.name: Force Incognito Mode
patches.description: Forces Gboard to always operate in incognito mode (disabling personalized learning and persistent input logging) while keeping clipboard functionality enabled.

patches.name: Hardened Intent Security
patches.description: Enables Gboard internal external intent protection against unauthorized intent hijacking.

patches.name: Resource Slimmer
patches.description: Strips embedded third-party license text, onboarding tutorial Lottie animations, and promotional GIFs using dynamic content heuristics.
